messages.subject: App is losing Rmarkdown format
parts:
I have one app that suddenly lost format elements from Rmarkdown. The application was working fine until at least last Thursday, when I executed it for the last time before today, when I realized this problem. This happened even without any new deploy. In fact, the last deploy is dated almost one month ago.
Anyone here has passed through this situation?

Thanks,
Fernando
